findings.claim: CONFIRMED: R16's new case `resolver-non-string-anchor-is-a-locate-failure` is GREEN on the pre-guard tree fb84a88, so it never graded the guard it ships for, and its committed triage.red_first records an AttributeError/failure:act that could not be reproduced — running the case verbatim on a detached fb84a88 worktree gives failure:locate.
findings.evidence: evals/adversarial/resolver-non-string-anchor-is-a-locate-failure.json:29 claims 'On fb84a88 (the tree before the guard) the same plan is failure:act — AttributeError: float object has no attribute strip'. Measured on fb84a88 with that exact file copied in: {'status': 'failure:locate', 'reason': "step 3 (extract): relocation after locate failure: retargeting as {'text': 'History'}; ResolveError: no tier resolved"} -> passed: true. Root cause: `anchor` is only read at narrowing rung 1 (resolver.py:534 `if anchor:`), reached only when a tier is AMBIGUOUS; the case's input is hello.html + {role: link, name: 'History'}, which matches nothing, so the float anchor never reaches _nearest. The three siblings DO go red on fb84a88. The guard IS real and IS gradable: same tree, resolver-narrows-by-anchor-proximity (forum-thread.html) with anchor: 4.82 gives failure:act / AttributeError on fb84a88 and failure:locate / ResolveError: target anchor is not a string: 4.82 on HEAD.
findings.repro: Add a detached worktree at fb84a88, copy the anchor case file in, run it through the adapter — passed: true, status failure:locate.
findings.acceptance: The anchor case's input reaches rung 1 (an ambiguous target — e.g. forum-thread.html + {role: link, name: 'user profile'} + anchor: 4.82), so it is failure:act with the AttributeError on fb84a88 and failure:locate with ResolveError on HEAD; triage.red_first quotes that measured pre-guard output verbatim.
